summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing first-quarter 2026 financial results. The release covers revenue of $128.3 million (up 19% year-over-year), subscription revenue of $117.9 million (up 23%), total ARR of $493.0 million (up 21%), and GAAP net income of $10.9 million. It also references the prior acquisition of SCG Canada Inc. on March 1, 2026. There are no new special-situation events such as M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or capital return. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings release, not a special situation.
